Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you
reported. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car.
Q: Where were you when the collision happened?
A: I was in Pearland, Texas, at an intersection on a main road. I was trying to make a left turn into a shopping center
parking lot.
Q: Walk me through what happened as you began the turn.
A: I had my turn signal on and I waited for a gap in oncoming traffic. There was a gap, so I started to go. Then a
vehicle coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Did you see that vehicle before you started the turn?
A: I saw headlights further back, but I thought there was enough distance. I misjudged it, I think.
Q: Were you able to get out of the car on your own?
A: Yes, but my right shoulder was hurting right away. I cuold barely lift my arm, and it's still sore now.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?
A: I went to urgent care the same day. They took X-rays and told me to rest it and follow up with a specialist.
Q: Did anyone else have a setabelt on, or were there passengers?
A: I was alone in the car, and I had my seatbelt on.
Q: Is there anything you wolud like to add to your account?
A: Only that I'm trying to get back to work, and the shoulder is limiting what I can do.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
